decision.reason: [ev-98d8079a3380] states only that the deprecated `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag "has been removed in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout`". It does not say whether an environment still passing the flag has it silently ignored (setting-ignored) or has the agent fail to start (workload-failure). The rest of the Removed Options section ([ev-ffd2c3200e89], [ev-32984cccce52]) doesn't settle this either. The proposed statement that the flag "will be ignored" is unsupported. Deciding the consequence needs upstream text or an artifact showing how the 1.17.0 agent handles the removed flag (rejected or ignored).
